# Fresh stress evidence archive — 2026-10-31

This file replaces the raw 100- and 200-round synthetic stress evidence trees. The trees were hashed, summarized and compressed here, then deleted. **The raw per-case JSON and Xcode bundles are not recoverable from this file; the hashes below are commitments to what was deleted, and every number reported in the two audit reports is retained here.** The graph output under `graphify-out/` was not touched.

## Deletion command

After this archive was written and its SHA-256 recorded, the raw trees were removed with exactly:

```bash
rm -rf tools/cde/fresh-100-20261030 tools/cde/fresh-200-20261030
```

`graphify-out/`, `.mirage-runtime/`, source, tests and docs were not part of that command.

## Limitations

The raw synthetic cases cannot be reconstructed from this archive; only the hashes, aggregates and small summary/log files are preserved. The outcomes are generated assumptions, not measurements of real readers. There was no independent hand grading, and the 200-round driver resumed at batch 176 after an interruption. The archive records what existed; it does not turn those artifacts into validation.
